headline: Not even a sharp nail is a problem. BYD Blade battery is designed to withstand extreme conditions and frequent charging
summary: BYD's Blade lamellar battery is described as among the safest and most reliable batteries for electric cars and plug-in hybrids. Other manufacturers have begun to imitate the design.
why: BYD is one of the world's largest electric vehicle makers, and battery technology is a key competitive factor in the EV industry. Battery design affects cost, safety and vehicle range.
